description: pyet is the pyet community's Python package for calculating reference and potential evapotranspiration from meteorological observations. It implements methods including Penman-Monteith, FAO-56, Priestley-Taylor, Hargreaves and Makkink, using pandas time series or xarray grids. Inputs vary by method and may include temperature, humidity, radiation, wind, latitude and elevation; outputs are daily evapotranspiration estimates. Geographic coverage and grid resolution follow the supplied data. Source is free under MIT, with documented examples, benchmark comparisons and calibration demonstrations. A limitation is that data requirements and benchmark coverage differ across methods, and potential evapotranspiration does not equal actual water-limited evaporation. pyet can prepare catchment water-balance and irrigation-demand inputs for infrastructure simulations. pyTSEB (model-pytseb) is a related energy-balance model for actual surface fluxes. No climate series or executable package was downloaded.
